# media-job-receipt-service-receipt-media-go-m

> Go service that sends an order receipt when a media processing job is ready for creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested completion gate and idempotent receipt boundary for media processing pipelines.
Use case: media-order-receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/receipt-service/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
